L18 and L19 (partition sets): the rate column is headed Rs/pc but the items are 'set of 5 strips' / 'set of 8 strips', so it is unclear whether the price is per set or per strip.
No board grade, GSM or BF is stated in the offer; the vendor says only 'manufactured strictly as per your specification', so no spec deviations are recorded.
FSC Mix is claimed (Q7 and letterhead) but no FSC certificate was attached.
The text layer splits row 7 across two lines (p1:L18-L19); the price 31.39 was read from the row as rendered.

The 4% discount applies only if cumulative annual order value exceeds Rs 50 lakh, and the email does not change this. 'Freight surcharge' for orders below one full truck (approx. 6 MT) is not quantified.
